import os
from shutil import copytree, rmtree
from subprocess import run

def build_frontend():
    print("Running npm build for frontend...")
    result = run(["npm", "--prefix", "frontend", "run", "build"], check=True)
    return result

def clean_static():
    print("Cleaning backend/static directory...")
    if os.path.exists("backend/static"):
        rmtree("backend/static")

def copy_frontend_to_static():
    print("Copying frontend build to backend/static...")
    copytree("frontend/out", "backend/static", dirs_exist_ok=True)

def main():
    build_frontend()
    clean_static()
    copy_frontend_to_static()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
